details.eligibility: Patients must have commercial insurance (excluding Medicaid, Medicare, VA, DOD, TRICARE, and other federal or state programs). They must also be a legal resident of the US or a US territory, with some states possibly excluded.
details.program:
-  Eligible patients may pay as little as $0 for every month of Dupixent
-  The maximum annual patient benefit under the Dupixent MyWay Copay Card Program is $13,000
-  Patient will receive copay card information via email following online enrollment & eligibility questions
-  Ongoing follow-up and education are provided by the Nurse Educator to help patients stay on track with DUPIXENT
-  Patient will be automatically re-enrolled every January 1st provided that their card has been used within 18 months
-  For assistance or additional information, call 844-387-4936, option 1, Monday-Friday, 8 am-9 pm ET
-  Pharmacists: for questions, call the LoyaltyScript program at 855-520-3765 (8am-8pm EST, Monday-Friday)
details.renewal: Patient will be automatically re-enrolled every January 1st provided that their card has been used within 18 months
